final: WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS avg_fill FROM per_order), above_overall AS (SELECT p.ordersmark, p.avg_fill, p.avg_fill - o.avg_fill AS difference FROM per_order AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.avg_fill IS NOT NULL AND p.avg_fill > o.avg_fill), second_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS avg_fill FROM above_overall), above_second AS (SELECT a.avg_fill, a.difference, a.avg_fill - s.avg_fill AS second_difference FROM above_overall AS a CROSS JOIN second_average AS s WHERE s.avg_fill IS NOT NULL AND a.avg_fill > s.avg_fill) SELECT AVG(avg_fill), AVG(difference), AVG(second_difference) FROM above_second
